notes.title: Game Update 0.14.2
notes.notes:
Hello, friends of Typing Valley!

Thanks to your continued feedback and support, we’ve made another round of improvements to make your stay in the valley even smoother and more delightful. This update focuses on bug fixes and usability enhancements—small details that make a big difference in your daily experience.
[hr][/hr]
Feature Improvements & Usability Enhancements

Item System Improvements: Reorganized item categories to make them clearer and easier to manage.

Orchard Optimization: Adjusted tree placement so fruits on upper branches are now easier to see and harvest.

Restaurant Lighting Update: Improved lighting to make interactive objects stand out and enhance overall atmosphere.

Visual Enhancements for Roads & Buildings:

Refined the appearance of signposts throughout the map.

Polished the look of construction signs in the estate development area.

Tooltip Improvements:

Extended tooltip display duration for easier reading.

Refined several tooltip texts for better clarity.

Adjusted fishing prompts for clearer and more intuitive feedback.

UI & Interaction Enhancements:

Fixed overlapping and misaligned UI text.

Updated stamina recovery rules after sleeping to make energy planning easier.

Stamina-recovery items now display their exact recovery value.

Improved guest “like” icons to better match recipe-related resources.

Repositioned cooking UI elements for clearer stove area visibility.

Control Improvements: Added support for pressing the Enter key during fishing interactions.
[hr][/hr]
System & Bug Fixes

Quest Fixes: All quest conditions have been corrected—they now complete properly and reflect each NPC’s preferences.

Data Handling Fixes: Improved data saving to prevent freezes and corruption in certain rare cases.

Recipe Unlock Fixes: Fixed an issue where guest likes were consumed but the recipe wasn’t correctly unlocked.
[hr][/hr]
💌 Thank you again for playing and sharing your thoughts with us.

Your feedback shapes Typing Valley into a more cozy, beautiful place each day.

We’ll keep listening—and typing—together. 💖

notes.title: Game Update 0.14.0
notes.notes:
Beneath buzzing cicadas and a warm summer breeze, Typing Valley has shot up a little taller: street-lights glow at dusk, restaurant patrons sport fresh haircuts, and the splash rings when a fish bites are bigger than ever. Step into the valley and see what new stories await!
[hr][/hr]

Gameplay & Fresh Features
Character Progress Panel

Check your level, portrait, and basic stats at any time and track the life you’ve built in Typing Valley.

Typing Vocabulary 2.0

Every interactive object now has a Familiarity meter. The more you type with it, the more related words you unlock—letting the world “talk back” as your understanding deepens.

Overhauled Recipes

New ingredient-type recipes: early cooking is no longer blocked by a single rare fruit—mix and match what you have.

Fewer seasoning categories for high-tier dishes, so your backpack (and brain) can finally breathe.

Restaurant Guest Makeover

Out-of-place NPCs have been permanently retired. Today’s diners switch hairstyles, aprons, and funky socks at random—occasionally you’ll even spot a suit-and-tie visitor escaping office life.

Evolved Day-Night Cycle

A re-drawn light curve: softer sunsets, darker midnights. Street-lamps, windows, and fireflies appear on schedule, and the kitchen window glows at dawn.

Crop Growth Stages

Fruit trees and veggies no longer sprout overnight—watch them inch from seedling to harvest with daily visual changes.

Tool Upgrade Path

Durability has retired; axes, hammers, and rods now climb an upgrade ladder toward Legendary status.

Lightweight Pop-ups

A tidy slip in the lower-left shows loot, stamina recovery, and more—leaving the center of the screen to the scenery.


World & Atmosphere
Environmental Additions

A playground, sandcastles, deckchairs, and a shower of shooting stars—Typing Valley now feels like a mini holiday.

Revamped Fish Ponds

Every pond has been restocked with species-specific fish—collectors can finally draft a true “Fishing Compendium.”

Night-time Highlights

Neon, signs, street-lamps, and window lights illuminate at just the right moments; keep your eyes up on evening jogs.

Restaurant Mood Tweaks

Alcohol is off the menu—parents can relax. Guest-unlock pacing has been adjusted so you meet familiar faces sooner.


Items & Resources
Reworked Chest Loot

Opening a chest is now worth the thrill—key seasonings and rare tools drop more often.

Higher Seed Drops

Fruit and vegetable seeds fall more frequently, turning gathering runs into pleasant surprises.

Backpack Upgrade Sooner

Reduced friendship threshold means you can haul a bigger bag earlier.

New Ingredients & Gear

Dozens of fresh materials join the collection list—kitchens and workbenches just got busier.


Controls & Interaction
Postal & Museum Typing

Long entries auto-paginate and track per-character accuracy—write essays without hiccups.

Full Localization Pass

Blank quests, recipe hints, vocabulary prompts—every missing string is now translated.

Fishing Feel Upgrade

Larger bite ripples, crisper sounds, longer line—learn the rhythm on your very first cast.

Faint-and-Wake Position Fix

On collapse you’ll reappear neatly beside your bed, not wandering by the window at 2 a.m.


Bug Fixes
We also shooed away a swarm of mischievous bugs. The full list would scroll for pages, so we’ll let you discover the smoother Typing Valley experience for yourself.


[hr][/hr]
The valley hums louder with every keystroke you make. May summer breezes, glowing lights, and the gentle return key inspire the next chapter of your warm-hearted adventure.

notes.title: Game Update 0.13.0
notes.notes:
In this version, we’re excited to bring you a wide range of new features and refinements to further enrich your pastoral life. Every enhancement reflects our dedication to creating a cozy and meaningful experience, all inspired by your valuable feedback. Let’s take a look at what’s new!



New Features & Systems

• Restaurant – Recipe Unlock & Upgrades: Players can now upgrade dishes by using ingredients, and research new recipes after upgrading the restaurant.
• Orchard System Introduced: Unlock and expand your orchard to grow fruit trees and harvest fruit periodically.
• Fish Farming System Introduced: Unlock and expand the fish pond to raise fish and collect them over time.
• Crop Farming Enhanced: Unlock and expand farmland to grow vegetables and harvest them continuously.
• Museum System Update: Donate rare items to the museum and write heartfelt stories for each exhibit.
• Restaurant Memory Scenes: During restaurant service, friends may recall touching life memories through special visual scenes while enjoying their meals.



Characters & Player Options

• Captain Character Redesign: The captain has received a complete visual overhaul, bringing a fresh and vivid look to this key NPC.
• New Player Gender Selection: Players can now choose to play as a boy or a girl when starting their adventure.



Control & Interaction Improvements

• Fixed an issue where stacked items could result in incorrect item types.
• Improved item stacking across multiple chests, making inventory management smoother.
• Players can now customize movement keys, improving compatibility with various keyboard layouts.
• Fixed an issue where certain music and sound effects were not affected by global volume settings.
• Fixed typing accuracy miscalculations in the post office—every character is now properly tracked.
• Typing experience in the Post Office and Museum has been improved: words will no longer be cut off when wrapping lines, and text will scroll smoothly if it exceeds the dialogue box.



Items & Resource Updates

• Added a large number of new items, including crops, fish, seafood, seasonings, museum artifacts, and advanced dishes.
• Fixed an issue where treasure chests would not drop items correctly.
• Fixed a bug where items dropped on the ground could not be picked up.
• Mining and woodcutting now have a chance to yield museum artifacts, adding more depth to your collection journey.
• Treasure chest drops adjusted, focusing on key seasonings used in recipes to support advanced cooking progression.
• Improved restaurant UI for cooking and recipe combination, making them easier to find and use.



Localization & Language Support

• Fixed several multilingual display issues, ensuring a smoother experience for players across different languages.



Every update is a reflection of our love for this peaceful countryside world. Thank you for your continued support and feedback—may these changes bring even more joy, emotion, and discovery to your farm journey!

notes.title: 0.12.4 Game Update
notes.notes:
To ensure your pastoral moments remain as smooth and comfortable as possible, we’ve meticulously refined and optimized the game—every change inspired by your invaluable feedback. Here are the warm improvements introduced in this update:

Game Settings and Control Support
• Supports various keyboard layouts, ensuring more accurate typing input (default movement keys on non-QWER keyboards are still under optimization).
• Both the Enter key and the Space bar can now be used as confirmation keys for more flexible operation.
• Pressing the Space bar quickly expands character dialogue, making interactions more convenient.
• New game setting: toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode.
• New game setting: adjust music and sound effect volumes.
• New game setting: customize movement keys (WASD or ESDF).

Core Gameplay and Controls
• Made food items edible—consuming them now restores stamina.
• When a word input error occurs, the game no longer restarts; instead, a shaking animation cues you to continue typing.
• Slightly increased the main character’s movement speed to enhance the exploration experience.

Store and Inventory Management
• Added a storage chest outside the restaurant, allowing players to store items.
• Upgraded storage chest functionality: one-click store, remove all items, and organize inventory options are now available.
• Introduced a new in-game shop for item sales, offering a wider range of choices.

Fishing and Treasure Chest System
• Removed the fake bite-hook action during fishing, resulting in a smoother experience.
• Enhanced the fishing and treasure chest systems with a chance to yield multiple items at once, keeping the surprises coming!

Map and Exploration Enhancements
• Added signposts at the entrance of each road, clearly indicating interactive points at the end.
• Adjusted the spawn rate of fruits in town, making harvesting feel more natural and engaging.

Interface and Visual Updates
• Completely overhauled the interface with a brand-new design for a more refined and cohesive visual experience.
• Added a total playtime display so you can keep track of your gaming duration.
• Formalized certain in-game objects for enhanced detail.
• Extra content in character dialogue boxes is now hidden to prevent overflow.
• The settlement panel now correctly displays icons for vocabulary, high-APM words, and incorrect words.

Sound Effects and Music
• Replaced certain sound effects to enhance overall audio quality.
• Updated the background music to create an entirely new atmosphere.

Multilingual Support and Text Corrections
• Optimized multilingual processing across various areas to minimize instances of Chinese text appearing in the English version.
• Corrected several text errors to improve overall language quality.

Other Enhancements
• Added a progress bar indicator to the special guest’s temporary eating scene for more intuitive interaction.

Every update reflects our passion and dedication to this warm pastoral world. Thank you for your continued support and feedback—may these changes add even more fun and surprises to your farm journey!

notes.title: Game Update - 0.12.2
notes.notes:
Typing Valley receives a brand-new upgrade! This update not only brings a wealth of new content, but also finely refines the details to present you with a more authentic and natural countryside experience. Here are the detailed updates—let’s take a look!


New Additions
• The mine map now features three brand-new terrains, adding more mystery and excitement to underground exploration.
• A new guest has joined the restaurant, enhancing the lively dining experience with extra interaction.
• Several new ponds have been added to the town map, decorating the town with a more vibrant scenery.



Visual Updates
• The robot in the restaurant has been replaced with official resources, boasting a more refined and realistic appearance.
• The proportions of the friends in the restaurant have been adjusted to the correct scale, ensuring more natural and coordinated interactions.
• The idle animation speed for all NPCs has been adjusted to be more relaxed, reflecting the serene pace of life.
• All types of fruit trees now have the proper shapes, showcasing a more natural growth state.
• Fruit trees across all maps have been rearranged according to their natural habits, creating a realistic natural landscape.
• The mine entrance on the town map has been meticulously modified to better match the ruins style, adding an element of mystery.
• Icon resources for fruits, tools, and more have been updated to their official versions, unifying the visual effect.


Store Page Optimization
• The promotional images, game screenshots, and logo on the Steam store landing page have all been updated to better capture the farming and serene pastoral atmosphere.


Every update is designed to make this ranch an even better place. Thank you all for your continuous support and enthusiasm. We hope these changes bring more warmth and surprises to your countryside life! If you have any suggestions or encounter any issues, please feel free to share your feedback. We will continue working hard to create an even more beautiful ranch world with you!
